read.title: First Amazon Live Stream
read.text:
Hi all,

Our first Amazon Live livestream for the Mugwort Clay Mask will be held this Friday. We'll be going live at 8 p.m. Eastern Time for 45 minutes.

Our host, beauty creator Jenna Moore, will show the mask on camera and answer viewer questions in real time. During the stream, we will offer a live-only 20% discount code.

Please send me any product facts you want her to mention by Wednesday. A short rehearsal is scheduled for Thursday at 4 p.m.

Thanks,
Minsu
